title: What Is SEO ? Search Engine Optimization Best Practices from Beginner to Advanced
description: SEO stands for Search Engine Optimization. It Is about how you can improve your content visibility, structure, and how users can easily find your content through search engines like Google, Bing and Other search engines

body.header: Following these rules and structures of Search Engine Optimization your page is going to rank at the top of Search Engine. What I learnt during 3 years of SEO I will break them down one by one and give you a real example of each of them
